digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center test Dockerfile provenance and licensing
propositions: Vendored Jira Data Center Dockerfile lacks upstream source revision, license identifier, protected license text, and modification statement in provenance header

Dockerfile comment header must document upstream repository pycontribs/jira, commit e3c7b167b065660605645cef7f101cbb324772e4, source path docker/jira-test-image/Dockerfile, and BSD-2-Clause license identifier

Upstream root LICENSE file from the pinned commit must be stored byte-identical at tests/external/live_jira_dc/pycontribs-jira-LICENSE.txt with SHA-256 digest a432e25d7fa27b288cc7ab6ea8e3a9aa27c101579de7fad7a3b5f534ba9e772a

Modification statement must identify only the added product.start.timeout flag and expanded operational annotations while confirming all base digest, Jira version, exposed port, and entrypoint instructions remain unchanged
Unit test in test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py must assert stored license bytes match expected digest without network or Docker harness access
